effect: Battle Mode: players start closer to the centre of the stage
note: Option > PASSWORD (4 digits). Handler $C5:68C4 sets $6246=1 and bit 0 of the code flags $6273/$6274; the stage builder reads $6246 ($C2:1B08). Lands on the Battle menu.

effect: Battle Mode: alternate hard-block and item layout
note: Option > PASSWORD (4 digits). Handler $C5:68CA, $6246=2. The three layout codes (4622, 0413, 0926) share $6246, so only the last one entered counts.

effect: Battle Mode: start positions moved inward with less open space
note: Option > PASSWORD (4 digits). Handler $C5:68D0, $6246=3. It does not unlock Gold Bomberman (one GameFAQs list says it does); Gold comes from a 100% clear, see the Gold Bomberman entry.

effect: Battle Mode: adds SUPER (スーパー) to COM LEVEL; stays unlocked
note: Option > PASSWORD (4 digits). Handler $C5:68E0: $6247=4 (number of COM levels) and bit 4 of $6273, which is saved to SRAM $1E8 ($C0:4858). At boot $C0:486D restores $6247=4 from that bit.

effect: Battle Mode: every soft block holds a power-up
note: Option > PASSWORD (4 digits). Handler $C5:6997, bit 5 of $6274.

effect: Normal Mode: start with 8 bombs, 8 fire, top speed, remote control, kick and power glove
note: Option > PASSWORD (4 digits). Handler $C5:6928, bit 3 of $6274; the stage script reads it ($C2:1ACB) and gives the full-power start ($C4:2926): $17CA=8 bombs, $4EBD=8 fire, speed $15EA:$15D2=$0200 (normal $00E0), and $4ED5=$07 = remote control (bit 0, bomb fuse $0E40=$FF, $C4:3059), kick (bit 1) and power glove (bit 2). Round 1 read $4ED5 as speed; it is the item bitfield. In play a 2657 bomb never went off on its own (900 frames); kick and glove were not exercised in play.

effect: Normal Mode: 9 lives and an 8:00 stage timer
note: Option > PASSWORD (4 digits). Handler $C5:69A9, bit 6 of $6274; the timer is picked at $C5:03A9 (8 or 3 minutes). The HUD showed 9 lives and 7:58.

effect: Boss rush: the Normal Mode bosses one after another
note: Option > PASSWORD (4 digits). Handler $C5:695E: mode $67 with $6254=0 (normal starting power). Starts straight in a boss arena. Bit 7 of $6274 also stops the game saving.

note: Option > PASSWORD (4 digits). Caravan only (table $C5:688D, handler $C5:69BB, $6272=1). Rejected by the retail ROM. The retail ROM still has the code path ($6254=1 at $C4:2926) but no password reaches it.

code: Super Joycard turbo X on the title screen
effect: Unlock battle stages 11-13 (kept in SRAM $1EA)
note: Holding X with the Joycard's turbo on is what works: $C1:75F9 counts new X presses on any pad. It needs 39-54 presses in 360 frames (6 s) with no gap of 16 frames or more. That means a 6.5-9 Hz turbo or fast tapping; holding X does nothing. Verified with 8-frame and 4-frame-on/4-off turbo (works), and with 4-frame turbo, 12-frame turbo and plain holding (fail). The Caravan ROM unlocks the stages at boot without this.

effect: Gold Bomberman joins the Battle Mode character select (replacing the random X)
note: The end-of-game certificate script ($C6:E07D) unlocks him if the clear rate in $103C is 100: script native 67 ($C0:4880) writes 1 to SRAM $1E9. Native 68 ($C0:4893) reads it at character select. Tested both halves: forcing 100 wrote the flag, and setting the flag showed him.

effect: Invincibility (the hit timer never runs out)
note: The flag that the orphaned password handler $C5:6951 would have set; $C4:2D2B reads it. Bomberman survived his own blast in Normal Mode with it held at 1. Caravan address is 7E6271 (not tested).

effect: Config Battle editor: body 9 (Subordinate Bomber) / color 7 (boss palette)
note: TCRF gives 7E62FD/7E62FE, which are the Caravan (gold) addresses. In retail the editor block is $1F lower; the decoder writes body/color to $62DE/$62DF. The editor variables were found in Mesen by cycling body/color; the PAR values themselves weren't tested.

effect: Debug room $AC (battle test): Zone 3 mine layout, players only, no music
note: Needs patches/sb5_debug_rooms.ips (tools/sb5/make_ips.py). Typed with real presses on the patched ROM. The patch copies the option password table to $C5:6FA0 and adds 0172/0173/0174.

effect: Debug room $AD (level test): battle stage 1 layout, two enemies, soft blocks with items
note: Needs patches/sb5_debug_rooms.ips. Scene $AD runs the room script at $C6:03B8.

effect: Debug room $AE (enemy test): one enemy, broken HUD
note: Needs patches/sb5_debug_rooms.ips. Scene $AE has no script (its entry in the scene table at $C6:0000 is $FFFFFF), which is why the HUD is broken and the room later goes black.

effect: PAR: the next valid option password goes to debug room $AC ($AD, $AE likewise)
note: $6248 is the scene run after the password screen (it becomes $1031); holding it overrides the code's own scene. Verified on retail by writing $6248 after the 4622 handler ran (Caravan keeps $6248 at the same address but was not tried). TCRF's 7E1038:XX was not tried; on the character-password screen $1038 is the cursor X, so it is a shared work byte.
